## 10b0b0da4c28

Concrete canonical counterexample: `self_check` rejects every canonical pair. Public marker colours commonly have exactly two cells, and some examples use only one marker colour, while the checker demands 2–3 colours and at least three cells per colour. Examples include canonical `train[1]`, rejected with `expected markers in 2-3 colors, found [2]` and `marker color 2 has only 2 cells; expected >=3`, and canonical `test[0]`, rejected because colour 4 has two markers. The generator therefore disowns the task's real manifold and overtrains a non-authoritative “at least three markers per colour” condition. Its declared dimension/count overrides are also silently inert because generation uses raw `rng.randint` rather than keyed axis draws.
